an4.174:1.1: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando yen' āyasmā Mahākoṭṭhito ten' upasaṅkami āyasmatā Mahākoṭṭhitena saddhiṃ sammodi
an4.174:1.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Ānando āyasmantaṃ Mahākoṭṭhitaṃ etad avoca :
an4.174:2.1: Channaṃ āvuso phassāyatanānaṃ asesavirāganirodhā atth' aññaṃ kiñcīti?
an4.174:4.1: Channaṃ āvuso phassāyatanānaṃ asesavirāganirodhā n' atth' aññaṃ kiñcīti?
an4.174:5.1: Mā h' evaṃ āvuso. Channaṃ phassāyatanānaṃ asesavirāganirodhā atthi ca n' atthi c' aññaṃ kiñcīti? Mā h' evaṃ āvuso.
an4.174:6.1: Channaṃ āvuso phassāyatanānaṃ asesavirāganirodhā n' ev' atthi no n' atth' aññaṃ kiñcīti?
an4.174:10.6: mā h' evaṃ āvuso ti vadesi,
an4.174:10.7: channaṃ . . . -nirodhā n' atth' aññaṃ kiñcīti iti puṭṭho samāno
an4.174:10.8: mā h' evaṃ āvuso ti vadesi,
an4.174:10.9: channaṃ . . . -nirodhā atthi ca n' atthi c' aññaṃ kiñcīti iti puṭṭho samāno mā h' evaṃ āvuso ti, channaṃ . . . -nirodhā n' ev' atthi no n' atth' aññaṃ kiñcīti iti puṭṭho samāno mā h' evaṃ āvuso ti vadesi. Yathākathaṃ pan' āvuso imassa bhāsitassa attho daṭṭhabbo ti?
an4.174:11.1: Channaṃ āvuso phassāyatanānaṃ asesavirāganirodhā atth' aññam kiñcīti iti vadam appapañcaṃ papañceti,
an4.174:11.2: channaṃ . . . -nirodhā n' atth' aññaṃ kiñcīti vadaṃ appapañcaṃ papañceti,
an4.174:11.3: channaṃ . . . -nirodhā atthi ca n' atthi c' aññaṃ kiñcīti iti vadaṃ appapañcaṃ papañceti,
an4.174:11.4: channaṃ . . . -nirodhā n' ev' atthi no n' atth' aññaṃ kiñcīti iti vadaṃ appapañcaṃ papañceti.
an4.174:11.5: Yāvatā āvuso channaṃ phassāyatanānaṃ gati tāvatā papañcassa gati,
an4.174:11.6: yāvatā papañcassa gati tāvatā channaṃ phassāyatanānaṃ gati.
an4.174:11.7: Channaṃ āvuso phassāyatanānaṃ asesavirāganirodhā papañcanirodho papañcavūpasamo
